items.title: How a grass fire at a Canadian military base killed four soldiers
items.description: Cause of grass fire remains unknown as PM Carney calls it one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canadian military.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine Should Focus on Peace Talks, Rubio Says
items.description: Rubio also appeared to confirm reports that the U.S., Russia and China are in talks to hold a summit of leaders to discuss ending the war.

items.title: Russia pounds Kyiv as Rubio urges Ukraine's Zelensky to 'focus' on ending the war
items.description: Russia on Monday said it carried out a "massive strike" on targets in Kyiv and its region as US Secretary of State Marco Rubio denied that Washington had paused intelligence sharing with Ukraine and urged its president Volodymyr Zelensky to focus on ending the war.

items.title: Inside the shadowy world of anti-Putin sabotage from within Russia
items.description: Two men tell of the work they say they have been doing to support Ukrainian intelligence during the war.

items.title: 'Life is absolutely brutal in Gaza,' says World Food Programme head
items.description: The UN's World Food Programme says 1.4 million people in Gaza are suffering acute food shortages and that funding gaps are forcing cutbacks in critical aid, despite the U.S. brokered Hamas-Israel ceasefire.

items.title: 'A tsunami of Jewish terrorism': Settler violence in occupied West Bank conceals ethnic cleansing
items.description: Ahead of Israel's upcoming October 27 parliamentary elections, several NGOs describe the methods settlers use to drive Palestinians from their land and the obstacles they place in the way of local olive harvests.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia Hit Energy Grid 76 Times Since Ceasefire Call
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced that Russian forces carried out 76 targeted strikes against Ukrainian energy and oil-and-gas infrastructure since US President Donald Trump declared an “energy ceasefire” a week ago. items.title: Flour sacks turned flood barriers: Gaza faces another winter without safe shelter
items.description: Like many people in the war-ravaged Gaza Strip, Ahmed Al-Omari is preparing for another winter of bitter cold and rain that threatens to cause flooding as families struggle to survive in tattered tents and damaged buildings.

items.title: Russia wants blackout in Ukraine as winter comes — Zelenskyy
items.description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy says Russia is trying to cut electricity and heating to civilians ahead of winter. He also called the US president's waiver of new sanctions on Moscow a boost for Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Trump Waives Graham Act Sanctions On Russia Before They Take Effect
items.description: US President Donald Trump has waived nearly all substantive sanctions, tariffs, and restrictions included in a bipartisan law aimed at pressuring Russia to end its war against Ukraine, prompting sharp criticism from Ukraine advocates and US lawmakers from both parties.

items.title: A broken peace deal is reigniting war in Ethiopia’s Tigray region
items.description: Issues left unresolved in the peace agreement that ended fighting in Ethiopia’s Tigray region in 2022 are pushing the area once again toward war.
